item.title: Taylor Decker Requests Release from Detroit Lions
item.description: Detroit Lions veteran left tackle Taylor Decker announced on Instagram that he has requested his release after 10 seasons with the franchise.

item.title: Taylor Decker Breaking News Would Save Detroit Lions TONS of Cap Space in 2026 and 2027
item.description: The Detroit Lions could free up significant salary cap space if they grant veteran left tackle Taylor Decker his requested release. Decker, who recently announced on Instagram that he has asked the team for his release after a decade in…

item.title: Report Reveals Why Taylor Decker Has Requested Release from Detroit Lions
item.description: A new report from the Detroit Free Press reveals that Taylor Decker requested his release after the Lions asked him to take a pay cut.

item.title: Detroit Red Wings Trade Elmer Söderblom to Penguins
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings traded forward Elmer Söderblom to the Pittsburgh Penguins for San Jose’s 2026 third-round pick just hours before the NHL trade deadline.

item.title: Dylan Larkin Injured in Red Wings Loss to Panthers
item.description: Detroit Red Wings captain Dylan Larkin left Thursday’s game against the Florida Panthers with a painful injury.

item.title: Red Wings Recall 1st Round Pick Under Emergency Conditions
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings recalled Michael Brandsegg-Nygard from the Grand Rapids Griffins under emergency conditions following Dylan Larkin’s lower-body injury.

item.title: Detroit Lions Land Combine Stud in Dane Brugler’s Latest 2026 NFL Mock Draft
item.description: In Dane Brugler’s latest 2026 NFL mock draft, the Detroit Lions land Alabama OL Kadyn Proctor and Penn State EDGE Dani Dennis-Sutton.

item.title: Detroit Lions Named As Potential Landing Spot for Jaelan Phillips
item.description: Sports Illustrated lists the Detroit Lions as a potential landing spot for free-agent edge rusher Jaelan Phillips, the No. 3 ranked EDGE available.

item.title: Detroit Lions Miss Out on Another Potential Answer at Center
item.description: The Detroit Lions lose another potential center option after Connor McGovern signed a four-year, $52 million extension with the Buffalo Bills.
